title: Stock arrangements until Sy Oliver and Willie Smith
summary: Crawford says the band played stocks until Sy Oliver arrived and contributed greatly, with Willie Smith and Wilcox also writing.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, tell -- now, you had -- when you all, when you all were off work like -- did the band -- did the band rehearse much?
Oh, yeah, stock arrangements. Until Sy Oliver got in.
So now, Willie Smith was -- wasn't Willie Smith writing arrangements and so forth?
Yeah, Willie wrote some, but when Sy got in there, well, it all backed down a little bit because Sy contributed a lot to Jimmie Lunceford's band. Wilcox even wrote.
